en.title: UK house prices constrained by high rates
en.thesis: Stagnant UK house prices in July, driven by higher mortgage rates and stretched buyer affordability according to Lloyds, indicate that UK residential price growth will remain below historical inflation rates over the next year.
en.rationale: Data from Lloyds and Halifax reports confirm that elevated borrowing costs and stretched buyer affordability continue to suppress momentum across the UK residential property market.
